comparison.objective: Select photo-matching parts from a conveyor and assemble a model while staging early arrivals.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual discrimination, timed conveyor picking, staging, and sequential assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Target model built without jamming the conveyor or retaining distractors; exact geometric scoring thresholds are absent from the available body.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is perception and scheduling under continuous transport, not force-controlled impact fracture or recovery of manufactured tangs.
